name: luci-app-gitbackup-ci
description: npm-based CI tooling for gitbackup/luci-app-gitbackup. Nothing here ships to a router: luci.mk copies applications/luci-app-gitbackup/htdocs verbatim and the OpenWrt buildbot has no node. No top-level "type": "module" on purpose -- tests/settings_cron_fixture.test.js (ticket 12) is a plain CommonJS script and stays one; every file this ticket added that needs ESM (tools/jsmin-verify.mjs, tests/history_view.test.mjs, tests/lib/extract_luci_view.mjs) uses the .mjs extension instead, which is unambiguous regardless of this setting.
